text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service=redwood-runtime-prod (policy=model-serving-latency) at us-west-2 — 1/3 escalations initiated.

maya: saw it too, getting the graphs now.

sam: oncall here — acked. quick check: any deploys in the last 10m?

jonah: no deploys, autoscaler event around 5032109500 but that finished.

raj: looking at the latency heatmap — spike pinned to a small subset of instances (gpu-pool-12). looks like KV cache misses.

elaine: paging history shows similar very-short spikes every ~45s for last 7m, PD auto-resolved twice already.

maya: if it's auto-resolving, might be noisy warmup or synthetic canary. can we confirm customer impact?

sam: checked SLO dashboard — 99th latency bump but error rate unchanged. no obvious user-facing errors in logs. likely degraded tail latency, short lived.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation 2/3 notified (oncall-secondary).

jonah: timeline: page 0 @5032109876 -> auto-resolve @5032109930 -> page 1 @5032109955 -> auto-resolve @5032110005 -> page 2 now. this is a flapping alert.

raj: running quick query on tracestore for problematic host:```
traceql
service:runtime
filter:host==gpu-pool-12
group_by:span.name
agg:latency(99)
range:-10m
```

maya: pinging infra to check GPU host health and mem pressure. @infra-oncall any eyeballs?

(pagerduty-bot): Reminder: please follow escalation policy.

sam: infra says GPU hosts show transient CUDA context stalls, kernel queue spikes. suspect driver-level hiccup. they restarted the CUDA daemon on two nodes at 5032110010, still seeing one more page.

elaine: adding reaction :eyes:

maya: okay, mitigation plan: 1) cordon the remaining noisy instance, 2) route traffic off it, 3) keep alert auto-resolve window increased to 3m to avoid churn. agree?

raj: +1 for cordon. also suggest temporarily widen alert window: from 30s to 180s, and require >3 hosts affected before paging.

jonah: created temp mute on PD for rule model-serving-latency:muted-by-oncall for 10m while we stabilize. link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345

sam: executed cordon + drain on gpu-12-07. traffic shifted, KV cache warmed on healthy hosts.

incident-bot: system: node gpu-12-07 cordoned by sam at 5032110058.

maya: we're seeing tail latency drop back to baseline on dashboards. looks auto-resolve will clear the page.

elaine: please log a follow-up to evaluate alert sensitivity — this flapping masks real incidents.

raj: quick note: replayed a failing trace — observed ~3x cache miss ratio while node under driver stall. filing ticket.

maya: filing ticket now: TICKET-3456 "Investigate transient CUDA stalls causing flapping latency pages" assigned to eng-runtime/reliability. include runbook updates for temporary mute and cordon steps.

jonah: keeping thread open for 10m to verify no further reoccurrence.

sam: postmortem candidate? feels low-severity but operational churn. let's set P0? no, P2. record RCA if repeats.

maya: agreed P2. add suggested alert changes in ticket: increase evaluation window, add host-count threshold, and add a suppression window for auto-resolve loops.

elaine: also add a follow-up with infra to check driver versions across pool, and consider rolling update for CUDA runtime on affected machines.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert auto-resolved at 5032110115.

maya: closing out — no customer-facing errors observed, hit internal SLO briefly. action items: TICKET-3456 created, temp mute removed at 5032110200, and we'll revisit alert tuning next week. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
